_doc: Hunger you can see (Brandon, 2026-11-22: 'SP seems like an afterthought, where it used to be a major issue and killer'). Below hungry_below of the belly (max SP) the hero is Hungry: a line, no cost. Below weak_below he is Weak: Strength weak_str and no natural healing until he eats. At 0 he is Starving, still Weak, and hunger wounds him each time he would have lost a point of SP (main._tick_sp, STARVE_SHARE). src/hunger.py reads this; the simulator plays the same rules.

lines.weak: You are weak with hunger: Strength -2, and your wounds will not mend until you eat.
lines.starving: You are starving! Hunger will wound you until you eat.
